valid.name: deploy_two_repositories
valid.description: two repositories, millisecond expires_at, empty edge_host

valid.name: deploy_single_repository_max_version
valid.description: one repository, largest safe blueprint version, expires_at one millisecond after the lease

valid.name: deploy_with_edge_host
valid.description: edge_host is preview_key followed by the preview base domain

valid.name: hosted_extend_with_desired_expiry
valid.description: extend sets desired_expires_at to current_effective_expires_at plus 24 hours

invalid.name: deploy_expires_at_sub_millisecond
invalid.rule: expires_at has at most millisecond precision

invalid.name: deploy_blueprint_digest_mismatch
invalid.rule: blueprint.digest is the canonical digest of blueprint.content

invalid.name: deploy_edge_host_foreign_key
invalid.rule: edge_host starts with preview_key and a dot

invalid.name: deploy_operation_digest_not_resealed
invalid.rule: operation_digest binds stable intent; a changed expires_at without resealing is refused

stateful.name: deploy_untrusted_commit_set
stateful.rule: a commit_set the runner never recorded for the execution manifest fails the commit_set phase

stateful.name: deploy_same_key_different_operation
stateful.rule: a resealed operation under an accepted idempotency_key is a conflict
